profile.headline: Software Developer at CapitalOne | Ex- Amazon, TrueCar, Inc., Cadence Design Systems

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed an application of Systems Manager Engineer operations which analyse logs and generate ‘Impact Analysis’ report to detect anomalies in the AWS systems.
•	Provided automation documents which delivers information about total error count with latest five errors messages and information about Operation names and their counts, account id and their count and stored them in AWS S3.
•	Provided custom settings for user to change parameters as alarm settings, error threshold, etc.
•	Designed and delivered an automized end to end system by connecting AWS services like SSM, Lambda, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, SNS, CloudFormation, AWS SDK.

positions.title: UTDesign Developer and Mentor
positions.description: I am working on "Keurig Dr. Pepper: Product Image recognition" project and mentoring undergrad students for the same project using convolution neural network and machine learning algorithms.

company.name: The University of Texas at Dallas

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed Compare framework and automation of it using NatTable to compare projects profiled, debugged, compiled data in one platform.
•	Developed numerous automation regressions for Xplorer (GUI based application) of 17 features owned by me using Java, Junit and SWTBot framework.
•	Designed, implemented and deployed statistical report generation system by using MySQL and web technologies to present single click regression reports, resulting optimization of processing time by up to 75%.
•	Implemented various Design Patterns for compare framework- factory design patterns, singleton design pattern, strategy design pattern, etc. optimized product by 7%.
•	Developed Python and Groovy scripts to profile and populate data for regressions. 
•	Successfully delivered total 8 product releases with 0 failure count of regression.
•	Refine over 45 existing automated test cases to make robust automation. 
•	Proactively identified and assessed discrepancies Mac compatibility issues in UI of Xplorer which is also deliver on Windows and Linux.
